sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quiet surge of panicked embarrassment and self-reproach, worried that starting the term late has already gone wrong.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: I only meant to look at the time...
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed, quietly trying to оправдать herself while inwardly panicking about being late on the very first day.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and flustered, with a brief spike of embarrassment and panic as the newspapers hit her face, though she tries to keep the reaction small.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed by the string of mishaps, but is trying to stay composed and push through the morning without panicking.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sudden surge of anxious relief and desperation, trying not to panic as she begs the bus to wait while still keeping her composure.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is quietly stunned and embarrassed, with a small, resigned hurt beneath her calm as she tries to accept the bad luck without showing much outward reaction.
sprite_sequence.label: sadness

sprite_sequence.text: Good morning. I'm sorry for... this shape.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is mortified and flustered, but trying to stay polite and composed by turning her embarrassment into a quiet, self-deprecating apology.
sprite_sequence.label: sadness

sprite_sequence.text: I haven't ridden one in a while.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels shy and uncertain, with a quiet flicker of embarrassment and apprehension about whether she can manage the bicycle after so long.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Maybe... maybe I can still make homeroom.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is quietly clinging to a fragile hope, trying to steady her nerves and keep going despite the morning’s humiliating chaos.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Why is there a daikon in the basket...
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels stunned and quietly exasperated, with a tired, almost disbelieving resignation at how absurdly unlucky this morning has become.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: ...This was supposed to be a good start.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels quietly crushed and embarrassed, with a small, resigned sadness at how completely her careful hopes for the day have unraveled.
sprite_sequence.label: sadness

sprite_sequence.text: I ironed everything. I checked everything. I really tried.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels quietly crushed and frustrated with herself, holding back tears as she tries to justify her effort and make sense of how everything still went wrong.
sprite_sequence.label: sadness

sprite_sequence.text: I'm fine. Just... losing to vegetables.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is embarrassed and near tears, but trying to cover her frustration with dry, self-deprecating humor and quiet composure.
sprite_sequence.label: sadness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed by her string of mishaps, but also quietly relieved and touched by his help, with a fragile attempt to stay composed.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Right. Running sounds simpler than cycling.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed but relieved, quietly accepting help and trying to regain composure with a small, tentative bit of humor.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exhausted and relieved in equal measure, with a faint, shy sense of triumph after barely surviving the morning’s chaos.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Please don't tell anyone about the daikon.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels shyly embarrassed and vulnerable, but also relieved and quietly grateful that the moment is over and he seems kind enough to trust.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

gpt.rationale: The sequence stays mostly subdued and inward-looking with fitting sadness/quiet happiness beats, but repeated fear sprites for urgent lines and a few broad reactions feel slightly stronger than this introverted character would usually show.

claude.rationale: Sprites track the emotional arc well (fear at rushing, surprise at mishaps, sadness at defeat, happiness at recovery), though the loud 'fear' labels feel slightly strong for a reserved character whose panic stays internal.
